note: Trust roots for protected-reporting activation (packages/core/release-authenticity.mjs). Empty means the protected runtime stays closed. Only the owner may add keys: a campaign release signing key (Ed25519 SPKI, base64 DER) held outside GitHub and Render, the transparency log key and at least witnessQuorum keys of independently operated witnesses. keyId is the SHA-256 hex of the DER key. Raising minimumSequence prevents rollback to older signed releases.
